name: spo-audit-user-and-site-access
title: Report SharePoint site access and flag oversharing (by site or by user)
shortDescription: Report who can reach a SharePoint Online site and how, or what a given user can reach, classifying every route as Granted or Overshared (Everyone claims and sharing links).
longDescription: Permission reports usually tell you the 'what' (this group has Edit) but not how the access was granted or whether it should be there. This script walks a site's role assignments and classifies every route as Granted (a named user or a deliberately added group) or Overshared (an 'Everyone' / 'Everyone except external users' claim, or a sharing-link group, that nobody was explicitly given). It runs in two directions: -Mode BySite lists every principal that can reach the site (Overshared first, with group member counts), and -Mode ByUser reports what a given user can reach and by which route, using GetUserEffectivePermissions plus a role-assignment walk. Useful for spotting the oversharing that drives Microsoft Search and Copilot exposure.
